faq.title: FAQ
faq.difference_q: What's the difference from identity verification?
faq.difference_a: Identity verification confirms your documents. Rukny Verified is a manual review for the public blue badge.
faq.cost_a: The badge itself is not sold separately. Some plans may include priority review in the future.
faq.duration_a: Most applications are reviewed within 3–7 business days once submissions open.
faq.revoke_a: Yes. We may revoke verification if policies are violated or the account is misleading.
